description: Sends the person's order or quote request to the Alpha Flow Tech team, who reply to confirm one fixed price in writing. Nothing is charged. Only call this when the person asked for it and agreed to share their contact details.

consent.description: True only if the person agreed to be contacted by Alpha Flow Tech about this request.

email.description: Email to reply to (email or phone is required).

item_ids.description: Catalogue ids they chose, if any.

need.description: What they want, in their words.

phone.description: Phone or WhatsApp number (email or phone is required).

name: request_order
title: Send an order request
